budget_contract.ceilings: Independent ceiling for each exact named unit; never add unlike units. Unknown reservations are tracked separately and block dependent work.
budget_contract.approval: Before each paid proof: require a fresh safe exact-operation estimate first, then purpose/model/parameters, authoritative cost basis and exact units, maximum, per-vendor and aggregate spent/reserved/unknown to Watt; Watt routes Elgar approval. An approval maximum cannot authorize itself. Unknown/stale/unsafe prices cannot be approved for submission.
budget_contract.identity: Persist intent before submission. Vendor job id is write-once. Replacement or uncertain submission becomes unknown. No automatic resubmission/retry after uncertainty.
budget_contract.cancellation: VM/graph cancellation and best-effort vendor paid-job cancellation are distinct outcomes. Neither transport disconnect nor a stopped UI proves vendor cancellation or refunds.

priority_workflows.contract: TTS HTTP raw audio, timestamps JSON, chunked streams and input WebSockets are separate operations. Models overview routes eleven_v4 through Text to Dialogue; do not assume every listed model is valid for the TTS endpoint. Per-request voice_settings overrides must not mutate persisted settings.
priority_workflows.limits: TTS endpoint default output mp3_44100_128; 192kbps Creator+, 44.1kHz PCM/WAV Pro+. Model limits and enum values remain in saved schemas/pages. Endpoint enable_logging=false zero retention is Enterprise-only.
priority_workflows.source_conflict: TTD WebSocket page says one voice for eleven_v4 / v3_conversational; TTS-vs-TTD guide says up to 10 for eleven_v4, one for v4_turbo. Do not assert a universal speaker limit; use the restrictive bound until vendor clarification.

priority_workflows.contract: Existing transcriber capability: transcribe(path, lang?) -> text/error and transcribeStatus. Proposed ElevenLabs plugin declares transcriber=true and exports those methods; existing active selection chooses it. No new transcription UI or edits to current whisper engine/remote endpoint.
priority_workflows.batch: Multipart POST /v1/speech-to-text: model_id required; file/source URL options preserved in exact schema. Synchronous result or webhook asynchronous acceptance; 202 is not transcript completion. Poll/get/delete transcript endpoints are separate inventoried operations. No unconfigured inbound webhook is assumed.
priority_workflows.limits: File minimum 100ms and <5GB; legacy cloud_storage_url docs say HTTPS <2GB and deprecated in favor of source_url. Up to 32 diarized speakers, five channels, 1000 keyterms (<50 chars, <=5 words each). Current media-delivery cap 256MiB is a host limit, not the vendor limit.
priority_workflows.surcharges: transcript_edit +30%, minimum 10 seconds; keyterms +20%, >100 terms minimum 20 seconds; detect_speaker_roles +10%; each channel billed at full audio duration. Preserve incompatibilities (edit vs entities/multichannel, role detection vs multichannel) from schema/page.
priority_workflows.realtime: WebSocket input_audio_chunk; partial_transcript is provisional, committed_transcript is stable for that segment. Manual commit/VAD are distinct. A host streaming session capability and consent/budget path are absent; batch transcriber signature does not establish realtime UI.
priority_workflows.blocker: SDK fetch body:string, response body:string and chunks:string[] are not binary/multipart transport; 30s request cap also conflicts with long synchronous transcription. Need external confined binary-upload and bounded async reconcile contract. Do not use curl argv or inherited credentials.

priority_workflows.contract: Listing/get/library search and sample playback are separate from add/edit/delete/design/remix/clone/train/verify. Design yields generated_voice_id plus base64 MP3 previews; create consumes chosen preview ID. eleven_ttv_v3 supports reference_audio_base64/prompt_strength; previews and reference guidance do not imply free generation.
priority_workflows.limits: Voice Library API unavailable to free tier; PVC creation Creator+. Voice Design overview says description 20-1000 chars, optional preview text 100-1000; exact schema can differ, retain both constraints. Existing default voices expire 2026-12-31 according to overview; do not migrate/delete voices automatically.
priority_workflows.permission: All existing voices/settings protected. Explicit independent owner approval before any creation/design/cloning/training or mutation. This task performs no listing against the account either.
